title: Meet Edge: More Action, Less Effort
summary: Meet Grindr Edge, our new premium subscription powered by gAI™. Explore Discover, Reconnect, and Insights, designed to help you connect faster and with less effort.
body_markdown:
A great connection can start with a single message. Finding the person you want to send it to can take a little more work. There's the scrolling, the wondering whether you're their type, and the chat you meant to come back to before it got buried in your inbox.


Those are the moments we wanted to make easier.


Introducing[Edge](http://edge.grindr.com/?utm_source=press&utm_medium=pr&utm_campaign=edge_register&utm_content=release) , Grindr's new premium subscription experience powered by gAI™, our proprietary AI technology built around how our community connects.


Earlier this year, we began[testing an initial version of Edge](https://www.grindr.com/blog/testing-edge-our-first-full-powered-gai-tm-subscription) in Australia and New Zealand before expanding to Canada and select U.S. cities. We listened closely to what worked, what didn't, and how we could make the experience even better. Now, a better Edge is available worldwide.


The idea is simple: less time searching, more time connecting, and better tools to help you make your next move.


### **Your next move, right up front**


Edge brings together three new features, Recommendations, Reconnect, and Insights, designed to make finding and connecting with people more intuitive.


The new **Edge Recommends** carousel puts opportunities to connect front and center as soon as you open Grindr. It brings together new faces from Discover and familiar ones from Reconnect, with helpful context about why someone is being recommended.


Maybe someone you had a great conversation with is visiting nearby, or a connection you haven't seen in a while is back online. Instead of starting your search from scratch, Edge helps bring those opportunities back into view.


Because sometimes, all you need is a little nudge to say hello.


### **Discover someone new**


We know the grid can offer a lot of possibilities. Sometimes, a few good ones are all you need.


**Discover** delivers a curated selection of up to five recommended profiles each day, personalized to help surface people you're more likely to click with.


Whether you're looking for a date, a hookup, or just seeing where things go, Discover gives you a more focused place to start. Think less endless scrolling and more time finding someone worth making the first move on.


### **Pick up where you left off**


Some of your best connections might already be in your inbox. **Reconnect** works like smart favorites, bringing promising past conversations together in one place so they're easier to revisit.


With helpful chat summaries, you can quickly remember what you talked about and where things left off. Maybe it's the guy you hit it off with before a trip got in the way, or someone whose messages got buried during a busy week.


Instead of searching through old conversations, you can pick things back up when the timing feels right. Your inbox has a history. Some of it deserves a sequel.


### **A little context, a little confidence**


Ever looked at someone's profile and wondered, "Am I his type?" **Insights** gives you additional context about the people you're interested in, using gAI to identify patterns in who someone typically reaches out to, including age groups, positions, or tribes.


It's not a crystal ball, but it can help you feel more informed about who you might click with and a little more confident about making the first move.


### **Built with your choices in mind**


Grindr users have simple, meaningful choices about how their information powers gAI.


To support Edge, we launched Sensitive Data controls built for today’s gAI features. They give you two clear choices, both available in Privacy Settings > Sensitive Data:


- **Personalize gAI Features** controls whether sensitive data and chat content is used to power gAI features in your Grindr experience, including Insights, Recommendations, and Reconnect.
- **Contribute to Smarter gAI** controls whether sensitive information and chat content is used to improve and develop future gAI features.


You can review and change either choice at any time. Turning off Personalize gAI Features means Insights, Recommendations, and Reconnect will not function for you, and you will not appear in other users’ experiences with those features. Turning off Contribute to Smarter gAI does not affect your ability to use Edge or gAI features.


To power Insights, with your consent gAI draws on profile information and activity on Grindr, including chats. That means some Insights about you may be visible to Edge subscribers who view your profile, even if you do not subscribe to Edge yourself. That is why all Grindr users can review their own Insights in Privacy Settings > Insights and delete any they do not want displayed.


HIV status, last tested date, testing reminders, the Poz tribe and tag, and vaccination status are not used for gAI features or training, regardless of a user’s settings.


### **A new Edge for Grindr**


Beyond the new features, we've also given Edge its own distinctive, premium look and feel, including glass-inspired navigation on iOS. The result is an experience designed to feel polished and intuitive, keeping the people and possibilities front and center.


And we're just getting started. We're already working on what's next, with more features and major updates planned throughout 2027.


Edge represents an exciting next chapter for Grindr. It's about using technology to make the experience more personal, remove some of the friction along the way, and help people turn possibilities into real connections.


Because at the end of the day, the most important part of Grindr has always been the people you meet.


**Edge is now available worldwide. Open Grindr, get to the good part faster.**
